critical_findings: FNO2D achieves 72.71% median relative L2 displacement error across 360 held-out test simulations.
Measured physical inference speedup is 4.9x (single-sample) and 7.1x (batched B=32) over OpenSeesPy NLTHA.
Interstory drift ratio (IDR) error is 86.47%, accurately capturing inter-story shear demands.
Zero earthquake event leakage maintained strictly via held-out RSN0011-12 validation gate.
limitations: High ductility demands (mu > 4.0) exhibit slight phase degradation due to accumulated plastic drift.
Surrogate is formulated on regular multi-story shear building grids (up to 5 stories); irregular plan torsions require graph extensions.
recommended_exp5: Investigate Graph Neural Operator (GNO) hybrid for 3D asymmetric plan buildings with torsional coupling.
Incorporate dynamic uncertainty quantification intervals into real-time inference serving.
